summary: Craig County, VA tower site on Earn Knob (Jefferson National Forest), built in the 1930s and listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Tower Gone; no removal date or condition is given in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Wikipedia says the Sinking Creek Mountain area has no official trails and can be reached by Earn Knob Road at its western end; no source describes the tower site itself today

events.note: Date registered July 31, 2018; nominated by Kristin Reynolds

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 3,608 ft (1,100 m); Wikipedia gives Earn Knob as about 3600 feet along the ridge. The record and story use the Register figure.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Register gives only a decade (1930s) for the build, so no built event is recorded. The gone status comes from the Forest Fire Lookout Association list, which gives no removal date. The Craig County history mentions fire towers county-wide, not this tower, and the story now says so in the text. No source describes the site, its remains or public access today, so the story says that plainly. No photo added.
